# Silent Thread

> Silent Thread is a game studio and dev-tools Lab from Colombia, founded by Esteban Estrada. It started as the work he did after hours. First game: Raccoon Heist, coming to Steam. Tagline: Quiet name. Loud worlds.

- Based in Medellín, Colombia.
- Founder: Esteban Estrada, Founder & Director. X: @Codestz_Dev. Site: https://codestz.dev
- Studio X: @silentthreadhq. GitHub: https://github.com/silentthreadstudio
- Contact and press: silentthreadhq@gmail.com
- The name is two words, both capitalised: Silent Thread.

## Games

- [Raccoon Heist](https://silentthreadstudio.com/games/raccoon-heist): A raccoon wins the worst casino in town. The Rat Mob wants their cut. A heist roguelite: defend the casino every night and pay the Rat Boss, Don Vermino, by dawn. In development, coming to Steam. No release date announced.

## The Lab

Open-source tools for AI coding agents, by the founder:

- [Guildhall](https://github.com/Codestz/guildhall): Code repositories as living 3D worlds.
- [Cockpit](https://github.com/Codestz/opencode-cockpit): Shells that keep running, subagents you can watch, a PR in the terminal.
- [mcpx](https://github.com/Codestz/mcpx): MCP servers as CLI tools, built for AI agents.
- [Hindsight](https://github.com/Codestz/claude-hindsight): Claude Code transcripts as interactive visualizations.
